And a slice that redefines or duplicates an element fails the review and the compatibility check

  Scenario: C8 Every business rule of the baseline has a criterion or a test (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR11 of section 8 and their coverage rows
    When each rule is checked against the coverage table
    Then every rule names at least one criterion or test that covers it
    And a rule that is an architecture constraint is covered by a guardrail or boundary test instead

  Scenario: C9 A replayed write with the same idempotency key is not applied twice (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a write to PATCH /guarantee-claims/{claimId} sent once and then sent again with the same idempotency key
    When the second request arrives
    Then it is answered with the stored result of the first and no second change is written
    And the key format is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S3-E4016-CON-AC6)

  Scenario: C10 A retried or timed-out activity of the workflow does not write its result twice (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an activity of GuaranteeClaimWorkflow that is retried or times out
    When the retry or the timeout is handled
    Then the activity writes its result once and the workflow reaches the same state as without the retry
    And the retry count and the timeout values are Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S3-E4016-CON-AC7)

  Scenario: C11 A status change the claim model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the claim statuses of the baseline and the list of allowed changes between them
    When a change not on the list is sent
    Then it is refused in the one problem envelope of C4 and the claim status does not move
    And the allowed change list is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S3-E4016-CON-AC8)
